Pin placed on the mapped road vertex at the uphill end of the first hairpin, 47.75108,-121.11650 (USGS ground 3,577 ft). The guidebook's Half Moon beta reads 'Regulations: Let common sense prevail.' and names no pass, while the same book flags the Northwest Forest Pass where it applies (Blue Lake and Snow Lakes trailheads, plus a general note that many areas need one): an omission, not a statement. With the land manager's fee-site list (no Tye Road site) and the row's own notes ("not a developed fee site"; parking_pass "no fee site identified"), the owner may accept the op in proposed_ops_held; if applied, access.fees still reads "None beyond the parking or entrance fee this route already lists" (fees not touched per the rules). access._raw untouched.

results.evidence: Ninth pass (r25, 2026-10-01). Row re-read read-only: itinerary.days[0].miles 6.2 (Foggy Dew TH -> #417 -> Merchants Basin junction -> Cooney Lake trail -> Cooney Lake), days[1].miles 12.8 with 'the full 6.2 miles back out', Cooney Lake pin distMi 8, no closure recorded. MILEAGE - NEW sources this pass, none a stated trailhead->Cooney Lake one-way figure: (1) WTA trip report 2018-10-07 (Foggy Dew/Martin Creek/Cooney/Switchback/Merchants loop): segment figures only - first big junction at 5 mi, then about 2 mi and 3 more mi up Martin Creek to the Cooney Lake junction, 17 mi loop total; summing would be computing, and it is the Martin Creek line, not the row's. (2) WTA trip report 2025-10-05 (Sunrise/Merchants/Cooney lollipop): 'a little over 17 miles' loop, no leg figure. (3) WTA trip report 2002-09-30 (Sunrise Lake): Cooney Lake junction at 5 mi, Merchants Basin one mile beyond; no lake figure. (4) WTA trip reports 2017-10-12 (#8515503172) and 2020-10-01: no per-leg figures in the text. (5) Methow Valley Trails Collaborative conditions page: Martin Creek #429 '6.2 miles one-way (add 2.3 miles from Crater Creek TH)', Eagle Lakes #431 5.6 mi - trail lengths only; again supports the owner note that 6.2 is the Martin Creek trail's own length, not a trailhead->lake figure. (6) Internet Archive full-text search for 'Cooney Lake' with 'Foggy Dew': nothing beyond the books already read. Net: still one stated figure on this line (8.5 mi, one author); no op on days[0].miles, days[1].note or days[1].miles. CLOSURE (report only, no op) - status: LIFTED. Methow Valley News 2026-08-20 listed Foggy Dew 417, Merchants Basin 417.1, Sunrise Lake 417.2, Navarre Way 414 and Pasayten Drive 405 closed for the Little Giant Fire; Methow Valley News 2026-09-03: 'The Little Giant fire closure order has been lifted from trails in the Sawtooth Backcountry.' The land manager's own current order, Little Giant Fire Closure Order 06-17-07-2026-40 (effective 2026-09-03, through 2026-10-31 unless rescinded; Wenatchee River/Entiat/Chelan Ranger Districts; also posted on InciWeb, fire 93% contained as of 2026-10-01), was read in full: its 'Trails Closed' list names only 12xx/14xx/15xx trails (Chiwawa, Entiat, Railroad Creek/Copper Basin area etc.) and does not include 417, 417.1, 417.2, 429, 431 or 434 ('Hunters Tr. 1417' is a different trail). The forest alerts page carries no Methow Valley or Sawtooth Little Giant alert today. The August closure no longer applies; nothing to record on the row.
